summary: Return structured release-doctor preflight failure when final-mile candidate authority is unavailable.
details: The package-excluded release doctor reports unavailable final-mile candidate authority as a failed automated check, blocks manual playtest inspection without inferring acceptance, and preserves all release authorization flags as false.
An explicitly requested JSON output is retained during release-doctor dry-run so operators can consume the blocked result and exit status deterministically.
